triggers.exact_missing_quantity: Selected NiTi wire lot allowable cyclic bending strain/stress and damage/fatigue envelope at selected diameter, temperature, prestrain and planned pilot cycles
triggers.why_required: Cannot set safe curvature/cycle hard stop or interpret STOP-1 without a specimen-specific integrity limit. W02 approximate transformation strain is not a fatigue limit.
triggers.target_source_or_type: Exact selected wire lot manufacturer technical data and certificate, supplemented by batch-matched single-wire bending/fatigue test if absent
triggers.what_closes_trigger: Documented lot-specific safe limit and uncertainty over the pilot rate/T/cycle domain, reviewed before loading.

triggers.exact_missing_quantity: Certified working/proof/burst pressure, cyclic bend compatibility, permeability and seal/feedthrough rating of the exact annular cuff, membrane, tubing, fittings and optical window
triggers.why_required: Cannot set pressure hard limit or claim repeatable sealed operation from generic pressure literature.
triggers.target_source_or_type: Exact selected component manufacturer ratings/design drawings and lab proof/leak test records
triggers.what_closes_trigger: Identified assembly-level limiting component and signed proof/leak/pressure protocol with uncertainty and safety margin before pressurization.

triggers.exact_missing_quantity: Optical transmission/distortion or sealed feedthrough compatibility of the exact selected sleeve/window/sensor method under pressure and bending
triggers.why_required: A local slip or transformation proxy cannot be treated as feasible while its sealed channel and packing perturbation are unverified.
triggers.target_source_or_type: Selected component technical specification and direct instrumented leak/visibility/perturbation bench test
triggers.what_closes_trigger: Measured under-pressure visibility, calibration drift, leak rate and marked-versus-unmarked mechanical perturbation inside approved limits.

policy: These are exact component/lot requirements, not authorization for broad literature search. Direct local calibration/proof is preferred where supplier data are absent. No source was fetched during preparation.
